title: Ядро Commerz — модули, порты и сигнатуры

sections.title: 1. Модули ядра и их публичные типы
sections.text:
Пакет `packages/core`, namespace `Commerz\`. Модули ядра (каждый — `Contracts/Data/Enums/Events/Exceptions/Internal` по необходимости):

| Модуль | Публичные типы (сокращённо) |
|---|---|
| `Attributes` | `Api`, `Spi`, `SpiKind` |
| `Money` | `Money`, `Currency`, `RoundingMode` (enum), `Rate` (bp), `MoneyAllocator` (`allocate(Money, list<int> weights): list<Money>`) |
| `Measures` | `Quantity` (int + unit), `Measure` (decimal string + unit, для атрибутов), `LocalizedText` |
| `Identity` | `EntityId` (abstract, UUIDv7), `Uuid7` (генератор, тестовый seam), `SellableRef`, `CustomerRef`, `ActorRef`, `IdempotencyKey` |
| `Context` | `CommerceContext`, `Contracts\ContextResolver` (#[Spi Implement], для хоста) |
| `Errors` | `CommerzException` (abstract: `code()`, `category()`, `context()`), `ErrorCategory`, общие: `InvalidCommand`, `NotFound`, `IdempotencyConflict`, `InvalidConfiguration`, `UnsupportedContribution` |
| `Configuration` | `CommerzConfig` (typed), `StockMode`, `CustomersMode` |
| `Schema` | `TableNames` (resolver), `CommerzMigration` (abstract base), `ConstraintNames`, `Contracts\SchemaOwnership` |
| `Operations` | `Contracts\Transactions` (`run(callable)`, joins ambient tx, sets `lock_timeout`), `Contracts\OperationReceipts` (idempotency) |
| `Outbox` | `Contracts\Outbox` (`record(IntegrationEvent)` в текущей транзакции), `IntegrationEvent`, relay-команда |
| `Plugins` | `Contracts\CommerzPlugin`, `PluginManifest`, `PluginRegistrar`, `ContributionKind`, `Contracts\PluginInspector`, `Contracts\Contributions` (lookup по kind+key) |
| `Stores` | `Contracts\Stores`, `Contracts\Channels`, `StoreId`, `ChannelId`, `CreateStore`, `CreateChannel`, `StoreView`, `ChannelView`, события |
| `Pagination` | `Page<T>`, `Cursor` |
| `Ports\Sellables` | `Contracts\Sellables`, `Contracts\SellableProvider`, `SellableSnapshot`, `SellableKind`, `SellableUnavailable` |
| `Ports\Stock` | `Contracts\StockAvailability`, `Contracts\StockReservations`, DTO, `InsufficientStock` |
| `Ports\Prices` | `Contracts\PriceResolver`, `ResolvePrice`, `ResolvedPrice` |
| `Ports\Promotions` | `Contracts\PromotionUsage`, `ConsumePromotionUsage`, `UsageLimitReached` |
| `Ports\Delivery` | `Contracts\DeliveryOptions`, `Contracts\ShipmentBooking`, `DeliveryRequest`, `DeliveryOption`, `Address`, `Parcel` |
| `Ports\Customers` | `Contracts\CustomerDirectory`, `CustomerProfile` |
| `Quotes` | `Contracts\QuotePipeline`, `Contracts\QuoteStage` (#[Spi Implement]), `QuoteAnchor`, `QuoteInput`, `QuoteLineInput`, `QuoteState`, `QuoteLine`, `Adjustment`, `AdjustmentTarget`, `TaxLine`, `QuoteResult`, `QuoteTotals` |
| корень | `Commerz` (корневой API), `Facades\Commerz`, `CommerzServiceProvider` |
